about: The ground, the pitch, the weather, the intervals, the rain, the umpire's warnings and the wrap-up at the end.

any: THE MCG. NOTHING QUITE LIKE IT IN CRICKET.
A BIG CROWD IN AT THE MCG. WHAT A PLACE TO PLAY.
THE G IS BUZZING. THE BIGGEST STAGE IN THE GAME.
LORD'S. THE HOME OF CRICKET.
THE PAVILION, THE SLOPE, THE HISTORY. IT'S LORD'S.
A FULL HOUSE AT LORD'S. THE MEMBERS ARE IN THEIR SEATS.
THE SCG. THE CROWD RIGHT ON TOP OF THE ACTION.
SYDNEY. THE STANDS TIGHT TO THE BOUNDARY BOARDS.
A GREAT ATMOSPHERE AT THE SCG.
LAKSHMI BLUFF. THE MOUNTAINS LOOKING DOWN ON THE GAME.
CRICKET AMONG THE PEAKS. WHAT A SETTING.
THE THIN AIR UP HERE AT LAKSHMI BLUFF. IT CAN CARRY.
A LOVELY DAY AT PARKLANDS OVAL.
THE TREES, THE PICKET FENCE. PARKLANDS IS A PICTURE.
A GOOD CROWD ON THE GRASS BANKS AT PARKLANDS.
A BIT OF GREEN IN THIS PITCH -- THE SEAMERS WILL LOVE IT.
GRASS ON THE SURFACE. EXPECT SEAM AND SWING EARLY.
DRY AND DUSTY -- THE SPINNERS WILL BE LICKING THEIR LIPS.
A DUST BOWL. IT'LL TURN, AND IT'LL KEEP LOW.
HARD AND CRACKED -- SOME WILL KEEP LOW, SOME WILL TAKE OFF.
YOU CAN SEE THE CRACKS. BATTING WON'T GET ANY EASIER.
THE SHADOWS STARTING TO LENGTHEN.
LONG SHADOWS ACROSS THE GROUND NOW.
UNDER LIGHTS NOW.

bunnings: BLUE SKY AND {temp} DEGREES. I'D BAT.
NOT A CLOUD ABOUT. GOOD DAY FOR IT.
lorry: GLORIOUS! SUNSHINE AND RUNS, I SAY!
WHAT A DAY FOR CRICKET! GET THE HATS ON!
grog: DRY AND SUNNY: THE PITCH WILL WEAR, AND THE SPINNERS WILL LIKE THAT LATER.
FAST OUTFIELD TODAY. PIERCE THE FIELD AND IT'S FOUR.

bunnings: GREY AND {temp} DEGREES. THE QUICKS WON'T MIND.
LIGHTS MAY BE NEEDED. THE BATTERS WON'T ENJOY THIS.
lorry: LOOK AT THAT CLOUD! IT'S GOING TO HOOP AROUND!
SWING BOWLERS' WEATHER! GET THE SLIPS IN!
grog: UNDER CLOUD THE BALL SWINGS. PITCH IT UP AND LET IT WORK.
LEAVE WELL OUTSIDE OFF TODAY. THE EDGES WILL CARRY.

bunnings: STICKY OUT THERE. THE BALL MAY GO ROUND CORNERS.
lorry: IT'S LIKE A SAUNA! AND THE BALL WILL SWING!
HUMID! THE BOWLERS WILL BE LICKING THEIR LIPS!
grog: HUMIDITY HELPS THE SWING, NEW BALL OR OLD. KEEP ONE SIDE SHINY.
HEAVY AIR: THE OUTSWINGER WILL BE THE BALL TODAY.

bunnings: {temp} DEGREES. THE FIELDERS WILL WANT SHADE.
HOT AND DRY. THAT PITCH WILL CRACK.
lorry: A SCORCHER! {temp} DEGREES! BRING ON THE ICE CREAMS!
BAKING HOT! THE BALL WILL FLY OFF THE BAT!
grog: HEAT LIKE THIS DRIES THE PITCH OUT: LITTLE SWING, MORE TURN AS IT GOES.
SHORT SPELLS FOR THE QUICKS IN THIS HEAT. SPIN DOES THE WORK.

bunnings: WET OUT THERE. THE COVERS HAVE BEEN BUSY.
lorry: THE RAIN! WE'LL GET SOME PLAY IN, SURELY!
SHOWERS ABOUT! THE SEAMERS WILL LOVE IT!
grog: DAMP PITCH, SLOW OUTFIELD. THE SEAMERS WILL FIND MOVEMENT. BAT TIGHT.
WET GRASS SLOWS THE BALL. RUNS WILL BE HARD WORK.

lorry: DAY {day}!
grog: DAY {day}.

lorry: {lost} OVERS LOST TO THE RAIN!
grog: THE RAIN HAS TAKEN {lost} OVERS.

bunnings: IT'S DOWN TO {overs} OVERS A SIDE.
lorry: {overs} OVERS A SIDE NOW!
grog: REDUCED TO {overs} OVERS A SIDE.

lorry: LUNCH! {team} {score}! WHAT A SESSION!
TIME FOR A SANDWICH! {team} {score}!
grog: LUNCH WITH {team} {score}. THE NEXT SESSION SHAPES THE DAY.
{team} {score} AT LUNCH. THE BOWLERS GET A REST.

lorry: TEA! {team} {score}! ONE SESSION LEFT TODAY!
TIME FOR A CUPPA! {team} {score}!
grog: TEA WITH {team} {score}. THE EVENING SESSION AWAITS.
{team} {score} AT TEA. FRESH LEGS AFTER THE BREAK.

lorry: STUMPS! DAY {day} DONE! {team} {score}!
THAT'S THE DAY! {team} {score}! SEE YOU TOMORROW!
grog: STUMPS, DAY {day}: {team} {score}. A NIGHT'S REST FOR THE BOWLERS.
{team} {score} AT STUMPS. THE MORNING WILL TELL.

bunnings: THAT LOOKS LIKE ENOUGH. TIME TO DECLARE.
THE CAPTAIN SHOULD DECLARE. THAT'S PLENTY.
lorry: DECLARE! GET THEM IN AND BOWL AT THEM!
SURELY THAT'S A DECLARATION! ENOUGH RUNS!
grog: THE LEAD IS BIG ENOUGH. DECLARE AND GIVE THE BOWLERS TIME TO WIN IT.
TIME MATTERS NOW MORE THAN RUNS. I'D DECLARE.

bunnings: RAIN STOPS PLAY. ON COME THE COVERS.
HERE COMES THE RAIN. OFF THEY GO.
lorry: IT'S POURING! EVERYONE OFF! COVERS ON!
OH NO, THE RAIN! JUST AS IT WAS GETTING GOOD!
grog: RAIN. THE BOWLERS GET A REST AND THE BALL GETS WET. THAT CHANGES THINGS.
A BREAK FOR RAIN. THE BATTERS WILL HAVE TO START AGAIN.

lorry: {lost} OVERS GONE!
WE'VE LOST {lost} OVERS!
grog: {lost} OVERS LOST. THE CAPTAINS WILL BE DOING THEIR SUMS.
{lost} OVERS OFF THE DAY. TIME IS RUNNING SHORT.

bunnings: THAT'S IT FOR THE DAY, I'M AFRAID.
lorry: THEY'VE CALLED IT OFF FOR THE DAY!
NO MORE CRICKET TODAY!
grog: PLAY ABANDONED FOR THE DAY. THAT HELPS THE SIDE HOPING FOR A DRAW.
NO MORE TODAY. A DAY LOST IS A DAY LESS TO WIN IT.

lorry: NEW TARGET: {target} OFF {overs} OVERS!
{target} TO WIN OFF {overs}! GAME ON!
grog: REVISED: {target} OFF {overs} OVERS. WICKETS IN HAND MATTER MORE NOW.
{target} OFF {overs}. A SHORTER CHASE SUITS THE HITTERS.

lorry: {overs} OVERS A SIDE!
IT'S {overs} OVERS A SIDE NOW!
grog: {overs} OVERS A SIDE. THE BATTERS WILL HAVE TO GO SOONER.
CUT TO {overs} OVERS A SIDE.

bunnings: SO, {need} TO WIN. WE'LL SEE IF THAT'S ENOUGH.
lorry: {score} FOR {team}! {chasers} NEED {need} TO WIN!
{need} TO WIN! THIS IS SET UP BEAUTIFULLY!
grog: {score}. {chasers} WILL WANT A GOOD START CHASING {need}.
{need} TO WIN. WICKETS IN HAND WILL BE THE KEY.

lorry: {result}! WHAT A GAME OF CRICKET!
{result}! THEY'LL REMEMBER THIS ONE!
grog: {result}. THEY EARNED IT WITH THE BALL AND THE BAT.
{result}. THE KEY MOMENTS WENT THEIR WAY.

lorry: AND THAT'S IT! {team} {score}!
ALL DONE! {team} ON {score}!
grog: {team} CLOSE ON {score}. PLENTY TO TALK ABOUT THERE.
{score} FOR {team}. A FAIR DAY'S WORK.

bunnings: THIRD BOUNCER OF THE OVER. NO BALL, AND A FIRST AND FINAL WARNING FOR {w}.
THE UMPIRE HAS HAD A WORD. ONE MORE OF THOSE AND HE'S OFF.
lorry: THAT'S TOO MANY! NO BALL! FINAL WARNING FOR {w}!
{w} HAS BEEN WARNED! HE'S PLAYING WITH FIRE!
grog: TWO BOUNCERS AN OVER IS THE LIMIT. {w} IS ON A FINAL WARNING FOR THE INNINGS.
A WARNING FOR {w}. HE'LL HAVE TO PITCH IT UP NOW.

bunnings: THAT'S IT. {w} IS TAKEN OFF FOR THE REST OF THE INNINGS.
HE WAS WARNED. NOW HE'S DONE FOR THE INNINGS.
lorry: HE'S BEEN TAKEN OFF! {w} CAN'T BOWL AGAIN TODAY!
UNBELIEVABLE! TAKEN OFF FOR BOUNCERS!
grog: {w} IS OFF FOR THE INNINGS. SOMEONE ELSE HAS TO FINISH THE OVER.
THAT'S A BOWLER DOWN. THE CAPTAIN WON'T BE HAPPY.

bunnings: {b} IS GOING TO REVIEW. LET'S SEE.
lorry: HE'S REVIEWING! {b} IS NOT HAVING THAT!
THE BATTER REVIEWS! WAS THERE AN EDGE?
grog: {b} REVIEWS. HE'LL BE HOPING FOR LINE OR HEIGHT.
A BATTER'S REVIEW. HE MUST FEEL IT WAS MISSING.

lorry: THEY'RE REVIEWING IT! THE BOWLER IS CONVINCED!
UPSTAIRS WE GO! THE FIELDERS THINK IT'S OUT!
grog: THE BOWLER TALKED HIS CAPTAIN INTO THAT ONE. WE'LL SEE.
A FIELDING REVIEW. THEY MUST THINK IT WAS HITTING.

lorry: OVERTURNED! HE'S OUT! THE REVIEW WAS SPOT ON!
THAT IS OUT! REVIEW SUCCESSFUL!
grog: THE TECHNOLOGY HAS FOUND IT. GOOD REVIEW.
OUT ON REVIEW. THE BOWLER KNEW.

bunnings: THE DECISION IS REVERSED. NOT OUT.
lorry: NOT OUT! HE'S SURVIVED! WHAT A REVIEW!
OVERTURNED! {b} LIVES ON!
grog: A GOOD REVIEW. THE UMPIRE MISSED THE DETAIL ON THAT ONE.
SAVED BY THE REVIEW. THAT'S WHAT IT'S FOR.

bunnings: NO CHANGE. THE ORIGINAL CALL STANDS.
lorry: IT STANDS! THE REVIEW IS LOST!
REVIEW UNSUCCESSFUL!
grog: A WASTED REVIEW. THAT WAS ALWAYS GOING TO STAND.
REVIEW LOST. THEY'LL REGRET THAT ONE.

bunnings: UMPIRE'S CALL. THE DECISION STANDS, AND THEY KEEP THE REVIEW.
lorry: UMPIRE'S CALL! IT STAYS WITH THE ON-FIELD DECISION!
SO CLOSE! UMPIRE'S CALL!
grog: MORE THAN HALF THE BALL HAS TO BE HITTING TO OVERTURN IT. UMPIRE'S CALL.
UMPIRE'S CALL: TOO CLOSE TO OVERTURN, SO THE REVIEW IS KEPT.
